claims.claim_text_normalized: The focal loss focuses training on a sparse set of hard examples and prevents easy negatives from overwhelming the detector.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Our novel Focal Loss focuses training on a sparse set of hard examples and prevents the vast number of easy negatives from overwhelming the detector during training.

claims.claim_text_normalized: RetinaNet with focal loss matches the speed of previous one-stage detectors while surpassing the accuracy of all existing state-of-the-art two-stage detectors.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Our results show that when trained with the focal loss, RetinaNet is able to match the speed of previous one-stage detectors while surpassing the accuracy of all existing state-of-the-art two-stage detectors.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The extreme foreground-background class imbalance during training is the central cause for one-stage detectors trailing two-stage detectors in accuracy.
claims.evidence_quote_short: We discover that the extreme foreground-background class imbalance encountered during training of dense detectors is the central cause.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The focal loss down-weights the loss assigned to well-classified examples to address class imbalance.
claims.evidence_quote_short: We propose to address this class imbalance by reshaping the standard cross entropy loss such that it down-weights the loss assigned to well-classified examples.

claims.claim_text_normalized: RetinaNet with ResNet-101-FPN achieves a COCO test-dev AP of 39.1 while running at 5 fps.
claims.evidence_quote_short: RetinaNet is efficient and accurate; our best model, based on a ResNet-101-FPN backbone, achieves a COCO test-dev AP of 39.1 while running at 5 fps

claims.claim_text_normalized: The focal loss outperforms the best variants of online hard example mining by over 3 points AP.
claims.evidence_quote_short: FL outperforms the best variants of online hard example mining (OHEM) [31, 22] by over 3 points AP.
